metrics.profile_summary: Senior marketing professional with over a decade of experience specializing in brand management and digital strategy. Proven track record in leading teams and executing integrated campaigns across retail, education, and tech sectors.

experience.description: Managed multiple London-based brands including MiniCabRide and Tripzee from Karachi.
Remote digital marketing management for a US-based company in Tyler, Texas.
Managing five brands; overseeing paid promotions, brand building, campaign calendars, and mentoring the marketing team.
Led admissions and marketing campaigns, managed budgets, and oversaw digital, print, and PR activities.
Executed PPC, SEO, and social media strategies; managed GA, Tag Manager, Shopify, and influencer collaborations.
Developed e-commerce strategies, managed themed photo-shoots, and introduced BTL activities like pop-up shops.
Planned branding objectives, managed digital content creation, and analyzed consumer insights for rebranding.
Managed AdSense launch in Pakistan and Dubai, focusing on strategic targets and revenue generation.
Responsible for BTL promotions and designing social media activities.

strengths: Strong technical proficiency in GA and ad platforms
weaknesses: Inconsistent dating in CV (future dates listed for 2025/2026)
evaluation.summary: Candidate exceeds experience requirements with a strong background in both digital and traditional marketing, proven people management skills, and direct experience with the required technical tools.
